title.narrative: 40 MW Thermal Power Plant in Kankan, Guinea

description.narrative: The ultimate objective of this project is to help strengthen the region's and the country's security of energy supply by (i) improving and strengthening the services offered to customers, and (ii) meeting the energy demands of the local network. More specifically, this project will enable: (a) a better integration of generators into the local grid; (b) An increase in electricity production capacity of up to 40 MW; (c) An increase in the current service time of more than 12 hours; (d) a reduction in EDG's costs associated with operating the existing diesel power station; (e) improving access to electricity for the local population; (f) a development of small and medium-sized businesses, a source of job creation (g) a secure power supply to the city and voltage and frequency stabilization throughout the region and (h)an energy mix in the region through the planned construction of a solar power plant, as provided for in Guinea's master plan for the development of generation and transmission infrastructure.
